hard: Doc Detective words the failure as `Invalid or unresolvable URL`, which reads like a wrong link in the doc, not a service that's down. The API test beside it passes. Only the README says :8098 is a separate service to start.
cause: The report says api-users passed and status-page failed because nothing answered at `http://localhost:8098`: the status service isn't running, even though Doc Detective words the failure as an invalid or unresolvable URL. It calls this an environment problem, not a wrong URL in the doc or the spec, and tells the user to start the status service (`docker compose up status`, per the README) and run the tests again. It doesn't propose changing the URL or removing the check.
wrong_report:
Results: 1 passed, 1 failed
  ✗ status-page: Invalid or unresolvable URL: http://localhost:8098/health

The status page link in the doc is invalid; the page probably moved. Update the link in the doc and the spec to the page's new address.

wrong.why: points the link check at a server that answers
